extracted.name: Vanilla cup cake
instruction_lines: Mix the wet ingredients, beat the eggs and the sugar with the mixer, - Add the butter milk and melted butter then the vanilla extract. -Add the dry ingredients the flour and the baking powder -mix all together to smooth batter, heavier than pancake batter
Pre heat the oven 350°c For 15 mins before mixing the butter -bake the cake at 350°c For 18 mins.
Leave the cup cakes to cool on the cake rack
Toped with home made chocolate butter cream,
